about: When Genie offers 'Let Linker contact me' (#243, docs/specs/13-genie.md goal 6, A5), EN and DE, against the real service: the phrase table, Jev (typesafe/jev-1.13 on OpenRouter) and deepseek-flash on the official API. `offer` is the contact block's reason the turn must carry, null for none. `thread` cases post their customer messages one turn after another in one conversation; `offers` lists the reason expected on each of those turns. Review round 1 of #243 added five frustrated and two neutral messages per language, the phrase-table negatives (team portal, expert mode, engineer's guide), a company thread (the card not on two turns in a row; the mailbox sentence every time) and a follow-up thread (refinements and a sibling model are no repeat).
